content.text: Mass & Confession Times Basilica Museum Sunday Bulletin Watch Mass Basilica Podcasts Donate General Parish Giving Mary Lead Us Campaign Easter Sunday Mass Times He is Risen, alleluia! We invite you to join us for one of the following Masses on Easter Sunday. Your friends and family are warmly encouraged to worship with us! We strongly encourage you to arrive early and carpool because of our limited parking in Old Town. please refer to our handy reference map below for detailed locations of our three lots.
